title: Batch status metadata loading for folder expansion
description:
Optimize folder expansion by batching metadata updates and using lower priority tasks to avoid blocking UI.

Location: Victor/ViewModels/SiteViewModel.swift:541-571

Current Problem:
- Loading metadata for 50+ files can take 200-500ms
- Each child update triggers separate view refresh
- Folder expansion feels sluggish

Implementation:
1. Use Task(priority: .userInitiated) instead of default priority
2. Batch all metadata updates in single MainActor.run block
3. Minimize view refreshes by grouping updates

Expected Impact: 10-15% improvement in folder expansion responsiveness
Estimated Time: 20-30 minutes

title: Cache filteredNodes computed property results
description:
Add caching to filteredNodes to avoid recomputing the entire filtered tree on every access.

Location: Victor/ViewModels/SiteViewModel.swift:165-237

Current Problem:
- filteredNodes is a computed property that filters entire tree on every access
- SwiftUI can call this 10+ times per render cycle
- Expensive recursive filtering without memoization

Implementation:
1. Add cached properties: _cachedFilteredNodes, _lastSearchQuery, _lastFileNodesHash
2. Check cache validity before recomputing
3. Add invalidateFilterCache() method for when fileNodes changes
4. Return cached result when dependencies haven't changed

Expected Impact: 15-25% reduction in render time when search is active
Estimated Time: 30-45 minutes

title: Consider refactoring FileNode to reduce @Observable overhead
description:
Long-term consideration: Evaluate removing @Observable from FileNode or converting to struct for better performance.

Location: Victor/Models/FileNode.swift

Current Issue:
- FileNode is @Observable class, making every property change observable
- Reference type overhead for observation tracking
- Changes propagate through entire tree
- SwiftUI must track all instances

Options:
A) Make FileNode a struct (major refactor)
   - Better performance but complex migration
   - Would require significant tree structure changes

B) Remove @Observable from FileNode
   - Only SiteViewModel needs to be @Observable
   - FileNode can be plain class
   - Manually trigger updates in SiteViewModel

Expected Impact: 5-10% overall performance improvement
Risk: High (requires careful architectural changes)
Note: Evaluate necessity after implementing Phase 1-3 optimizations
